<!-- pr-reviewer: 38551b08e843186aee48ae7dcc547c91e9ee4ef8 -->
**Needs changes before merge** — the code is clean; the PR conflicts with current `main` (one file, a test suite header). No code blockers were found. A non-code refresh is the only thing owed; it is the author's step, not the reviewer's.

## What looks good
- The eight tools run the very undoable commands the GUI queues (`UpsertDocumentComponent`, `DeleteDocumentComponent`, `SetToolAssembly`, `SyncDocumentComponent`) — one History step, per-tool derived records. The library save/delete are file edits with atomic writes, and the live gate classifies them as FileWrite and the library-reading tools as FilePathAccess.
- The wire form is the `.camproj` form (`ComponentDto` / `LinkDto`, `deny_unknown_fields`), so MCP and the file share one parser and one set of refusals. An upsert of an insert states its own `milling` / `running` / `lathe_body` (#3646 / #3643) and keeps the held row's values otherwise — the lathe-body carry is correctly reflected in both the code and the new pinning test.
- The hand-resolved stack conflict from #4233 is correctly reflected: the merge `b0ce3cc8e` kept both sides of the `tool_library_holders.rs` mod list and the header, and the current head carries both `component_mcp` and `lathe_stack`. The rest of the refreshed #4233 (component tables, stacks, lathe body) is already in main.
- Named refusals are consistent with the GUI laws (no `library_ref` on an upsert, `builtin:` ids refused for library save/delete, no-op edit refused, running data and lathe body refused for library save, `set_tool_assembly` null clears and keeps records).
- The process/doc chain is consistent: the body has `Process change: yes` (the skill is a process file), `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched (diff: 12 files, none is the process version), the generated reference `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` (132 tools), the guide `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` and the skill `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` list the new tools, and `mcp_doc_drift` passes. The new tests join the existing `tool_library_holders` directory suite (no new top-level test binary, Gate map names `app::mcp`).

## Results
- Self-hosted runner (`pr-test.yml`, run [45971851798](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45971851798)): refused at the trial merge step — `Trial merge with main` failed, the PR conflicts with `main` (nothing was built on the runner).
- Local, head `38551b08e` (worktree `cc-pr4268-review`, no merge of main — the PR head alone):
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_library_holders`: **42 passed, 0 failed** (5 new `component_mcp` tests pinned).
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift`: **9 passed**.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
  - `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main --dry-run`: 169 steps mapped (the MCP tool table); not run in full — the pinning and drift suites cover the touched modules.
- Light lane: not run. The release build does not finish inside the 10-minute foreground window (two attempts, both cut by the timeout). The author's recorded result (`cargo xtask gate light`, 6 steps, 0 failed, at the stale head `dda741331`) is recorded in the PR body; the delta since then is a 3-line change plus a test in the MCP layer, which the light twins do not cover.

## Targeted tests
- pinning: `component_mcp` (5 tests, all green in the suite run) — no example-catalog suites needed (no post or toolpath change), no example catalog touched.
- Heavy: none owed (P6, not under the safety floor; this is MCP tooling, no geometry/output change).

## Requested before merge (numbered)
1. Refresh the branch against current `main`: `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs` conflicts (`git merge origin/main`). Both sides added a module to the same two hunks (the header comment and the module list): keep `component_mcp` (this PR) and `camtools_v8` (main, #4261), and both header/Gate-map additions. Then re-run the gate on the refreshed head and push a fresh head; the review of this head stands only until then.
2. Update the PR body's gate results: they are recorded at the stale head `dda741331` (169 steps, 28.3 min, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=5`); the current head `38551b08e` should carry fresh results once the refresh is pushed.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The MCP read tools (`list_tool_components`, `get_tool_assembly`) are deliberately not on the local read-only allow-list of the fallback (`fallback.rs`), so a local model must confirm them. That is a safe default, worth a line in the skill if the maintainer wants the read tools fast-pathed.
- `upsert_tool_component` cannot clear a held `milling` / `running` / `lathe_body` (a missing key keeps the held value) — same rule as the GUI's component edits; no way to remove one exists in the tool. Fine to leave, but the skill could say it.
- The PR is stacked on #4233, which is now merged; the stack-safety concern from the PR body ("do NOT merge this PR before #4233") is moot. The merge in this branch correctly inherited #4233's hand-resolved conflicts.
- The `gh pr view --json mergeable` field reported `MERGEABLE` while the git trial merge and the runner both conflict in `tool_library_holders.rs` — the authoritative check here is the trial merge, which conflicts.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Not mergeable right now - conflicts with main. No code blockers found; the refresh owed is the only thing left.** Feat PR (`feat(mcp)`): merges at the next cut, never in the merge sweep.

## What looks good
- Eight MCP tools, three new files of `crates/app/src/mcp/` (`component_tools.rs`, `assembly_tools.rs`, `component_library_tools.rs`), chained into the table with one line (`component_tools::all()` in `tools.rs`). All document write tools run the same undoable commands the GUI queues, in one History step: `upsert_tool_component` -> `UpsertDocumentComponent::with_row`, `delete_tool_component` -> `DeleteDocumentComponent::new`, `sync_tool_component` -> `SyncDocumentComponent::new`, `set_tool_assembly` -> `SetToolAssembly::new` / `::clear`. Verified in the diff against the command constructors the GUI and tests use.
- One wire form for the file, the library and MCP (`ComponentDto`, `deny_unknown_fields`, `LinkDto`), parsed once, strict named refusals, no `unwrap()`/`expect()` on the paths. `library_ref` and `builtin:` ids are refused. No MCP change writes a field directly; no geometry or post code is touched.
- Process files obey the law: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` lists all eight tools; the body says `Process change: yes`; `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged (164, same as main). New docs (`docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`, `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md`, `docs/decisions/3647-component-mcp-tools.md`) match the code, and the drift suite pins them.
- The previous refresh left `tool_library_holders.rs` with both sides kept (`component_mcp` and `camtools_v8`). The remerge-diff of `05b11de75` shows exactly that one hand-resolution, no logic change.

## Review of the head (`05b11de75`)
- `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 4268 --reviewed 38551b08e` -> DELTA (one hand-resolved test-list conflict, `tool_library_holders.rs`). The remerge-diff is that one resolution and no other change.
- Evidence gathered against main `ec314174e`. That was the main the runner used; main then moved to `df13bbaf6` (#4280) while this review waited. A fresh check against current main is below.

## Results (at head `05b11de75`, tree merged with `ec314174e`)
- On the self-hosted runner (`pr-test.yml`, run [45983715103](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45983715103), conclusion success, main `ec314174e`): trial merge clean; `cargo xtask gate quick` on the merged tree: 169 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (incl. `tool_library_holders`, `mcp`, `mcp_live`, `mcp_doc_drift`); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Local light lane (release, worktree at `05b11de75` merged with `ec314174e`): 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (11 light tests), wall 7.6 min.
- No post or toolpath change: no `example_catalog*` tests owed. No `P1` safety change: no targeted heavy step needed.

## Conflict (the one owed item)
`git merge-tree --write-tree 05b11de75 origin/main` now reports CONFLICT in `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs`. Main (`df13bbaf6`, #4280) added a `builtin_collets` module and a doc line in the same hunks this branch added (`component_mcp` and its doc line). GitHub reports `CONFLICTING`. This conflict is not the code of this PR: both sides added lines to the same header and module list.

## Requested before merge (the author refreshes, this does not change code)
1. `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs`: `git merge origin/main` and keep both module lists and both header doc lines (`component_mcp` and `builtin_collets`), same resolution as `05b11de75`. No other file conflicts.
2. Push the refresh, re-flag the PR for a fresh review at the new head (the marker of this review does not cover the new head).

## Notes
- The green runner result and light lane above ran against main `ec314174e`. Main moved while this review waited; the fresh green evidence at the new head comes with the refresh, then a fresh review.
- This PR is ready today but is set back to draft until the refresh is pushed (per the conflicts rule).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
